description:
#### Fixed
- **Download media failed to patch on some builds of Instagram 456.1.0.56.78** (the larger
  APKMirror bundle): the post menu builder is an instance method there, and the patch only looked
  for a static one. Both shapes are found now.

---

Oxbow for Instagram 456.1.0.56.78 (patch bundle 1.3.5). Earlier patch bundles for this
version, and what they changed: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

- **oxbow.apk** replaces Instagram (uninstall Instagram first).
- **oxbow-clone.apk** installs next to Instagram.
- **patches-1.3.5.mpp**: patch Instagram yourself in [Morphe Manager](https://morphe.software): add the source `github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow`.

Obtainium: add `https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow` and set the APK filter to `oxbow\.apk$` or `oxbow-clone\.apk$`.
